Settings → Music on hold: four built-in classical guitar tracks, your own uploads, a default, and each campaign (inbound or outbound) can choose its own. A call that waited with a queue's music keeps it.

Calling out: the agent hears the phone ring from the moment the customer is dialled, instead of silence.

Office extensions: an agent can call a colleague's extension on the office PBX by clicking their name, or by typing the extension on the keypad.

Campaigns on every channel: Campaigns now lists calling campaigns, journeys and broadcasts together, with each one's channels, a channel filter, and pause/resume on each. A switch per channel (Calls, SMS, WhatsApp, email) stops all of that channel's campaigns at once; messages due meanwhile wait and go when it is switched on again. SMS, WhatsApp and email campaigns are now plan permissions of their own, apart from agents answering on the channel; everyone keeps what they have.

Agentless AI campaigns: answered calls go straight to the AI, with no agent.

Campaign chaining: a finished lead (out of tries, reached, or either; by disposition if you like) goes on to another lead list or into a journey, after a wait you choose.

Lead scoring and the best time to call: every open lead has a score (0-100) and its best hours to call, from how the customer has answered before; refreshed daily. Campaigns can call each lead at the hours they answer, and the likeliest first. The lead list shows the score.

Local presence: a caller-ID pool with local presence on shows a number from the called person's area (then their country), worked out from the numbers themselves in any country.

Signed caller ID (STIR/SHAKEN): with a certificate set under Carriers, calls to the United States, Canada and France are signed; inbound, the carrier's verdict is shown on the agent's incoming call.

Carriers: calls refused because they came from an address no carrier lists (usually a carrier's second address) are shown on the Carriers page, with one-click Trust. Internet scanners are left out.

Recordings can be copied to your own SFTP or FTP (FTPS) server, into a folder a day and named your way, each checked on arrival; earlier recordings can be sent for a range of days. The platform keeps its own copy.

Downloads and playback always come from the address you are using: a reseller's customers see the reseller's own domain, never the platform's storage address.

Templates: ready-made post-call surveys, wallboards and alert rules.

Figures checked end to end (service level, abandoned, answer rate, occupancy, handle times, forecasts, adherence and more) so every screen, report and wallboard counts the same thing the same way, and days and months follow your time zone. Billing: interest is charged once, on the amount owed and not on earlier interest; the tenant's own payment terms apply; invoices paid in Xero clear the account within the hour; card payments pay the invoice's amount; storage and seats are counted correctly. Sales, Number Manager and tickets use local months and days, and pipeline values are not added across currencies.

Built-in hold music is fetched once by each call server (FreeSWITCH's public-domain pack, checked against its checksum)."}
